statement: The emotional peak (first page at the book's highest intensity) falls in the last third in 28 of 43 analysed books; in the other 15 the first peak comes earlier (mid-book reveals, plateaus, bedtime books that peak mid-way and wind down, or books whose last-third high only matches an earlier one).

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (35), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver: Pratham Books (5), Room to Read (1); 2014-2026

analyst_note:
2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. The wordless journey peaks at page 6 and holds through page 9 before a quiet return: a second plateau shape.
2026-10-15: Counts: support 5 earlier + Ga Mohana, Feathered Friends, Zuko (Book Dash) and Bohlale (African Storybook, first 4 at 0.71). Contradict: Bathtub Safari, Come Back Cat, Khumo (Book Dash, Khumo borderline), Chicken and Millipede (African Storybook, peak 5/5 at 0.45, about 3+ on the engine's 0-3 scale) and Good Night, Monu (StoryWeaver, peak 4/5 at 0.5-0.67, about 2 on 0-3). Two of the counterexamples are bedtime books that peak mid-way and wind down; see c_bedtime_closes_circle. 2026-10-20: +8 works (6 Book Dash, 2 StoryWeaver/Pratham). Goodnight, Tinku! is a plateau from p4 to p8 of 11 that winds down: counted as counterexample. Kottavi Raja peaks again at p16 of 17 after a second, city-wide problem.
2026-10-28: +6 support, +3 counter. StoryWeaver: Get Down, Rocky! peaks at the ramp (0.70) and The Lost Ball when the friends leave (0.71). Book Dash: A Day Out 0.73, Let's Go Looking 0.82, Dudu's Hat 0.82 and Goldfish Genius (plateau 0.64-0.91, climax 0.82) support; Who Ate My Hat (reveal at 0.55), Clever Pig (plateau from 0.55) and the bedtime A House for Mouse (plateau 0.42-0.67) count against. Peak position measured as (page-1)/(pages-1). Sources of the new works: Book Dash — A Day Out, Who Ate My Hat, Let's Go Looking, Dudu's Hat, Clever Pig, A House for Mouse, Goldfish Genius; StoryWeaver — Get Down, Rocky! (Pratham Books), The Lost Ball (Room to Read, translated from Bangla).
2026-10-28 older-book observation, NOT counted (SOURCES.md keeps populations apart): Millions of Cats (Internet Archive, 1928, Gág, study_only) supports (peak at 0.76).
2026-11-13: +6 support, +4 counter, measured as the first page at the maximum of the CLI emotional curve. I Can Do It! (p5 downhill ride = p10 tug-of-war, 4/5), Alex's Super Medicine (p5 = p11, 4/5) and Sweet Dreams (p5 = p7 = p11, 3/5) reach their high early and only match it later; A Trip to the Tap peaks at the lost bucket mid-book (3/5, about 2 on the engine's 0-3 scale). Sources of the new works: Book Dash — A Trip to the Tap (2023), Going Places (2025), AAAAAHHH!!!! Mmawe! (2024), Can We Eat a Rainbow? (2026), I Can Do It! (2026), Play with Me (2026), Banzi's Busy Bees (2025), Dance, Khuzwayo, Dance! (2023), Alex's Super Medicine (2022); StoryWeaver — Sweet Dreams (Pratham Books, year not shown).
